summary: The is_mount test checks whether a path is a mount point on the controller.
questions: How do I check if a local path is a mount point?
Is is_mount the same as mount test?

answer_card.title: is_mount test (controller paths)
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.is_mount` (same as `mount`): true if the path is a mount point on the **controller**.
